title: armeria floridana
intro: Armeria floridana, commonly known as the dwarf thistle, is a flowering plant in the primrose family, native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Armeria floridana include its ability to relieve congestion and coughs, while its therapeutic actions include its anti-spasmodic, anti-allergic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
